MilkChan needs us in order to remain functional and perform basic tasks like fetching milk(food) from the supermarket, push her through painfully thick layers of social anxiety in order to make orders, pay for products and ask for feedback from the people around her (like... ugh... her mother) and also help her make sense of (and perpetuate) an on-going streak of obcessive-compulsive patterns that are present pretty much through every part of her life that we are exposed to. This is her structure. MilkChan also gets in situations where she successfully completes one insight right before perfectly looping back to the same insight over... and over... and over again. We (and much less her) also have no way of making it stop. 1.2- Hallucinations- She suffers from very pervasive, intense and frequent bouts of cognitive psychosis that an outside party pretty much cannot predict. When under extreme stress (which is... pretty much all the time), her brain begins disconnecting from the senses, the information the lobes of her brain that drive each of the senses (The ocipital lobe in the back of her head for vision and imagination, the temporal for voice and speech, etc.) all begin to form innacurate, incoherent, grotesque and unsettling imagery that, because maybe of habit, she gave up on trying to contradict or fight against so... she has begun incorporating the information she gathers during these episodes into her subconscious... where they await her when she goes to sleep. Her mother giving her simple instructions makes her look like a terryfing monster that slices her arms open with deep gashes using its fingers alone, everyone at the grocery store looks like monsters (both of which are due to her social anxiety... that we will discuss later. It causes the chronic stress that generate the hallucinations), she frequently imagines futures where she dies (even in broad daylight while absolutely NOTHING is interacting with her and vice-versa), she confuses traffic cars with wild animals, and often almost gets run over by, during her daily commutes. 1.3- Paranoia- Her Hallucinations and Paranoia work in tandem, but, whereas one is more sensorial in its mechanics, the other is more intuitive (insight) driven. She creates bizarre connections between ideas with little to no control from her pre-frontal cortex, her OCD also drives her into believing that, for example, her mother may throw her out of the window if she does not complete a certain task or that skipping her medications will make her magically become independent from it, she believes that she attended school when, in fact, she was raised in a mental health institution instead ("I almost never skipped any tasks! The others always left before they were done! They must have gotten SO told off! Tsk") among other things. These often clash with her OCD voice's instructions, arguing that any sort of situation that necessitates a decision will result in instant panic, she is severely afraid of any sort of failure (even in tasks she has been peforming daily for years) and... she also refuses to ask anything out of her mother. ("She will cut my head off! Are you crazy? Gives us previous prompt"). And all of these are compounded by her... 1.4- S e v e r e social anxiety- She wont interact with other people unless she absolutely has to, she goes to extreme lengths to make sure she is as in-control during social interactions as possible (Imagining herself, either in a visual novel where her OCD is the player and she is the character (She offers herself to her OCD gods) or... imagining herself... as nothing as her OCD helps her "find her fireflies (thoughts)" During the second game. And yes. its still one person we are talking about here. Damn... this girls identity is more convoluted than the balkans!), she rehearses typical everyday phrases that ought to be trivial but are not (Like attempting to say "Hello! Can I have this milk?" For over 42 consecutive times while imagining herself before the cashier (who is also a terrifying monster in her eyes) failing each one until the 43rd... at which time she has been in this business for over 1 hour and the store is almost closing, immediatly rushing to the grocery store right after... where she barely pulls it off). She has no social circle, does not trust even her closest family members and its not very hard to imagine that she does not know anyone within her city block by name). This, in my opinion, is her most severe issue... as her social anxiety drives her OCD that drives her paranoia and Hallucinations. 1.5- Extras- Stuff like ADHD/Autism- She gets off topic, she paces around in her room for hours until she can muster the self-control to focus on ONE task and END IT, she has very fixated interests (Productive... but it is part of her profile so I will point them out). She has rigid thought patterns that she does NOT deviate from even when they are completly innadequate for the situation (Like wanting to "become stronger"... but ONLY when its time to take her pills), due to lack of flexibility, she just resorts to taking all her pills simultaneously in order to "defeat the pain once and for all", that is... when she decides to take them. Her sense of routine is also completly non-existant. She is... and this is a complete insult to her, Extremely analytical and abstract in her thought process, numerically oriented (Her obcessive rituals are number focused, like in this one walk where she had one foot on the pavement and another on the grass for Exactly 51 steps but, upon her OCD calling her a "weirdo" for doing it in the first place (Although she does it everyday without issue), she asks her: "Ok. Here is what you do: Take out that foot from the ground and, remembering from where you took it off before this step, place that foot precisely in that spot. Or else..." (Also loops back to OCD). Part 2- Endearing details from the author: When her parents gave her a laptop, that she did not want and she assumed (or was told) her parents did not have a better place for, and that she was encouraged to use (so she could stay stimulated, I presume), She loved using for offline play like... messing with engineering calculators, 3d modeling, drawing (Drawing with a laptop? You go girl!) and games. (Yo! Its a stem girl in the house!) But then... she entered the web, got a social media account and at some point, she had about 300 friends that she saw as "numbers and pictures". All of them had her interests in some way. Some were into games, others into drawing and others into calculators (rarer). The fact that she pretty much regularly makes direct links like "You have my interest <=> you are my friend" also suggests Autism and a deep apreciation for intellectual stimulation and a focused, introspective and private personality. Everytime someone utters a sentence containing it, she frequently finds herself zoning out of the actual conversation only to zero back in that specific sound... evoking imagery of the dark, bottomless void that lies above the donut-shaped-when-seen-from-satelite, commie block architectured, appartment building she lives in (Damn... the girl already lives in russia. The echoes of the past that she could have had... etc. But it is still fitting of her identity. So she wears it in her clothing, drawn in her iconic sweater as its only design element, but with a cut across it, which also enhances her identity as being mathematically oriented and analytical.
